sentences: On the small island of Corvo in the Azores, about four hundred and fifty people have agreed to live in the dark for a while.
Since October twenty-first, the streets and public buildings have turned off their lights at night, and the **blackout** will last for almost three weeks.
The reason is a seabird called the shearwater: around six thousand pairs **nest** on the island, and their young birds leave home at this time of year.
The young birds, which usually find their way to the ocean by following the light of the stars, can easily be **confused** by bright street lamps and fly **inland** instead.
en.answer: 아조레스 제도의 작은 섬 코르부에서는 약 450명의 주민이 한동안 어둠 속에서 지내기로 했다.

sentences: Seit Anfang Oktober wird die wichtige **Bahnstrecke** zwischen Hannover und Berlin gründlich erneuert, und die Arbeiten dauern bis Dezember 2027.
Die Bauarbeiter erneuern dabei nicht nur die **Gleise** und die Oberleitungen, sondern modernisieren auch insgesamt 27 Bahnhöfe entlang der Strecke.
Ab dem Fahrplanwechsel im Dezember fahren die Fernzüge einen **Umweg** über Braunschweig und Magdeburg, sodass die Fahrt etwa achtzig Minuten länger dauert.
Wo keine Züge fahren können, sollen **Ersatzbusse** die Fahrgäste zu den nächsten Bahnhöfen bringen, damit niemand ohne Verbindung bleibt.
de.answer: 10월 초부터 하노버와 베를린을 잇는 중요한 철도 노선이 대대적으로 보수되고 있으며, 공사는 2027년 12월까지 이어집니다.
words: 우회로, 돌아가는 길 (남성 der, 복수 Umwege)
